title: Glowing bowl of noodles
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='42' ry='38' fill='#ffaa00' opacity='0.12'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='34' ry='30' fill='#ffbb22' opacity='0.12'/>

  <!-- bowl body -->
  <path d='M18 52 Q17 82 50 86 Q83 82 82 52 Z' fill='#ff6b3d'/>
  <path d='M22 56 Q21 78 50 82 Q79 78 78 56 Z' fill='#ff8c5a'/>
  <!-- bowl rim -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='32' ry='9' fill='#ffa06b'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='32' ry='9' fill='none' stroke='#ffcc99' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- inner bowl shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='26' ry='6.5' fill='#cc4a22'/>

  <!-- broth -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='25' ry='6' fill='#ffdd44' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- noodles -->
  <path d='M30 50 Q35 38 42 50 Q48 60 55 48 Q62 38 68 50 Q72 58 70 51' fill='none' stroke='#ffe88a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M32 53 Q38 42 45 52 Q52 62 58 50 Q65 40 70 53' fill='none' stroke='#fff2aa' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M28 54 Q34 44 40 54 Q46 63 53 52 Q60 43 66 54' fill='none' stroke='#ffe88a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- egg half -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='49' rx='7' ry='4.5' fill='#fffbe6'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='49' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#ffb700'/>

  <!-- green onion slices -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='48' r='2' fill='#55ee66'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='48' r='0.8' fill='#aaffaa'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='55' r='1.8' fill='#55ee66'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='55' r='0.7' fill='#aaffaa'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='44' r='1.8' fill='#55ee66'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='44' r='0.7' fill='#aaffaa'/>

  <!-- steam -->
  <path d='M35 40 Q32 32 37 26' fill='none' stroke='#ffddaa' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M48 38 Q45 28 50 22' fill='none' stroke='#ffddaa' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M62 40 Q65 30 60 24' fill='none' stroke='#ffddaa' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='38' r='1.5' fill='#ffee88' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='36' r='1.5' fill='#ffee88' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='1.2' fill='#ffee88' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- chopsticks -->
  <line x1='68' y1='44' x2='88' y2='18' stroke='#ffa06b' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='72' y1='46' x2='92' y2='22' stroke='#ff8c5a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
